name: Mobile Applications
heroSubtitle: Innovative mobile applications designed to connect with users, simplify everyday tasks and bring your ideas to life.
shortDescription: We design and develop mobile applications that help businesses connect with customers and deliver useful digital experiences.
fullDescription: TOP TECH helps transform mobile app ideas into practical digital experiences. We work with businesses, entrepreneurs and organisations to plan and develop mobile applications based on their goals and target users. Whether you need a customer-facing app, a business tool or a service platform, we focus on intuitive design, useful functionality and a consistent experience across supported mobile devices. The technology and platform are selected according to the project's requirements.

processSteps.title: Discovery & Planning
processSteps.description:
Discovery & Planning
Step Description: We discuss your app idea, target audience, goals and the essential features required.

processSteps.title: UI/UX Design
processSteps.description: We plan the app structure, user journeys and visual interface to create an intuitive experience.

processSteps.title: Development

faqs.question: Should we build a native/cross-platform mobile app or a PWA?
faqs.answer: We help you evaluate both based on your audience: cross-platform apps for App Store and Google Play distribution, or installable PWAs for fast browser-based rollout.

faqs.question: Can the mobile app share data with our website or web dashboard?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both web and mobile interfaces can connect to the same unified database and API layer.

faqs.question: Do you help with Google Play and Apple App Store preparation?
faqs.answer: Yes. We prepare build packages, app icons, screenshots, and metadata checklists for store review.

idealFor: Businesses launching customer mobile apps, booking platforms, or field-team companion tools.
